name: Lens Wipe
description: A round glass lens grows from a point over the first clip, casting a soft shadow, and shows the second clip magnified through it with a bright bevelled rim; as it fills the frame the magnification relaxes. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point the lens grows from (0..1, y down)

params.name: strength
params.description: How strongly the lens magnifies the middle of the second clip at the start

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the rim's light and shade and of the lens shadow (0 for a clean cut)
